title: 118 Magicky zolik
prompt: A single ornate joker playing card floating upright in the air in a dark room, the card's face shows a painted grinning jester with a three-pointed hat with bells, the card glows and is wreathed in swirling bright blue magic flames, tiny glowing symbols of a sword, a crystal and a stone orbiting around the card, blue sparks. No real people. Vibrant, highly saturated colours, glowing bright blue magic light dominates the image. No text, no letters, no numbers on the card.
